demo_caption: Demonstration with real but simplified interface.
demo_label: A board of two projects, where a team adds a task, starts one, changes a bug to a chore, adds a label, moves a card to the other project and resizes the panels.
highlights.text_1: Matches show up in each project at the same time, so you never search one project after another.
highlights.text_2: Edit a description together, with each person's cursor and name in view. Nothing waits for a save.
highlights.text_3: Tasks are stored locally for offline search and direct updates. Changes are synced as you get back online.
pricing.text_1: Ideal if you are just getting started.
pricing.text_2: For those that have multiple projects in production.
showcase.from_cella: Of all code is from Cella
tagline: A very fast issue tracker for small teams with many projects. Fully EU-hosted & free to use.
text_2: Most issue trackers make you navigate between projects, boards, and issue pages. Raak keeps everything in a single page view.
